messages:
lee: alert from support: tenant A seeing 409s on SCIM user create and recent SSO failures. logs show SAML assertion decryption errors and duplicate extid mapping.

oz: can you paste the minimal logs?

lee:
```
2026-06-10T14:05:01Z ERROR idp-proxy saml: assertion_decrypt failed cause=DecryptionError kid=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:cmk-old req=rt-9001
2026-06-10T14:05:02Z WARN scim/provisioner create status=409 body="duplicate_external_id" extid=ext-42 req=rt-9001
```

sara: kms-bot shows key rotation around 14:00:03Z for alias/tenanted-enc (rot: r-20260610-02).

kms-bot: Rotation completed for alias/tenanted-enc at 2026-06-10T14:00:03Z (rotation-id r-20260610-02).

oz: looks like a mix of old-encrypted assertions hitting services that still have cached keyrings, causing decrypt fails and fallback behavior producing duplicate extid entries in the DB.

sara: also noticed an RBAC cleanup yesterday removed the service principal mapping that the dedupe path relied on; so when decrypt fails we do a lookup under a generic principal which is now missing -> leads to a race creating a second user record.

lee: mitigation?

oz: restart idp-proxy and provisioner to pick up new key material. also run a small migration to merge duplicate extid rows for the affected tenant and add a uniqueness constraint that tolerates short-term rotation windows.

sara: I'll roll a hotfix that rejects create when decrypt fails (fail-closed) to avoid dupes while we fix key cache invalidation.

kms-bot: scheduled: add SNS notify on rotation to infra-internal topic.

lee: doing rolling restart now. will monitor.

oz: follow-ups: 1) subscribe services to rotation notifications and auto-invalidate key caches; 2) add pre-rotation canary that verifies all active pods can decrypt sample payload; 3) review RBAC prune process to avoid removing principals used by fallback/dedupe code paths.

sara: created SEC-2026-301 and assigned to oz and infra for the notification wiring.

lee: restart complete, decryption errors dropped and support confirms tenant A scim creates recovered. closing incident as sev3 with postmortem to follow.
